instagram.caption:
Unpopular opinion: fighting games are the best competitive genre.

In Street Fighter, every loss is your fault. No teammates to blame, no lucky loot drops. Tekken runs on reads and nerves. One clutch comeback beats any shooter highlight. Smash Bros. Melee is still played competitively 25 years later. Name another genre that does that. Agree?
